parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is a curved metal rod, often with a plastic grip, used for carrying the bucket.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points on the bucket body to facilitate carrying and pouring.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the bucket is a cylindrical container made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds liquids or solids and provides the main storage capacity of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed, rigid part that does not move; it supports the handle and contains the contents.
